summary: Represents animation clip channel data for Clip Blender CHOP workflows, with rule/callback DAT support, rotation-order control, transitions, and loop behavior.
key_concepts: Clip CHOP is a TouchDesigner Pro operator documented as part of the Clip Blender CHOP animation workflow.
The official parameter surface defines rule and callback DATs, rotation order, transition mode, blend timing, next-clip controls, loop behavior, index channel, position type, and rotation type.
Transition chooses Blend or Wait Until End, while Blend Time and Next Blend Time control how clip changes are smoothed.
Position Type and Rotation Type choose whether root motion overrides, blends to the end, blends to the Clip Blender target, or adds to existing motion.
Pause at End holds clip playback at the end rather than immediately continuing through the broader clip sequence.

key_params.name: transtion
key_params.note: Transition mode: blend or wait until end

key_params.name: abspos
key_params.note: Position type: override, blend to end, blend to target, or add

common_gotchas: Official docs mark Clip CHOP as TouchDesigner Pro-only.
Clip CHOP is normally used with Clip Blender CHOP rather than as a general-purpose animation mixer.
Rotation order and rotation type must match the source asset or root motion can twist unexpectedly.
Rule and callback DAT paths should be validated before executing a generated plan.
The documented parameter token is spelled transtion, so atlas data should preserve that TD parameter name.
